entities.name: Rorix Bladewing
entities.description: Shivan dragon champion who became a pit-fighter, died in the Grand Coliseum and was reanimated as the undead Bladewing the Risen.

entities.name: Verix Bladewing
entities.description: Descendant of Rorix who mourns his existence and is prepared to destroy him.

entities.name: Karox Bladewing
entities.description: Descendant of Rorix who mourns his existence and is prepared to destroy him.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out a large chunk of Shiv.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Dominarian land of the Shivan dragons, partly phased out by Teferi.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Rorix fought as a pit-fighter and now haunts the skies.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum

entities.description: Dragon brood originating with Rorix Bladewing.

events.summary: Teferi phases out a large chunk of Shiv, and some Shivan dragons leave to restore their race's pride, Rorix among them.
